test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 04 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.**

Improved policing/ is vitally but/ not sufficient.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error in the sentence lies in the segment** "is vitally but."**
 
• **"Vitally" i**s an adverb, but it needs to modify an adjective in this context.
 
• The corrected part of the sentence should be** "is vital but."**

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *"Improved policing** is vital but **not sufficient." *
